scope: Incremental research archive through 2026-10-24; not exhaustive historical migration or complete Oct-23 source listing audit

items.title: BAM! Bayesian Anything Model: a foundation model for generative computational imaging
items.decision_boundary: Primary known-operator formulation; blind-kernel pipeline and nonlinear exploration must not be erased by overgeneralization.

items.title: RelayVSR: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Efficient Real-World Video Super-Resolution
items.decision_boundary: A100 model-computation latency excludes future-reference waiting and non-model work.

events.change: Separate model first-output time from input lookahead and end-to-end latency.

items.title: FlowTool: Controlling Tool Parameter in Image Retouching via Flow Matching
items.decision_boundary: Static renderer tool order is assumed; assets subject to approval; not arbitrary tool planning solved.

items.title: ExpandDiff: Dynamic Range Expanding Diffusion for Single-Image HDR Reconstruction
items.decision_boundary: Clipping robustness does not prove factual reconstruction in unobservable regions; full experiment protocol pending.

items.title: The Camera Inside the Editor: Reading the Implicit Camera of Image Editors with Painted Calibration Patterns
items.decision_boundary: Probe of tested editors, not a universal calibrator or universal focal-bias result.

items.title: Multidimensional Observer Model and Perceptual Dimensions of Human Image Quality Assessment
items.decision_boundary: Task-dependent low dimensionality is not a universal two-axis IQA conclusion.

items.title: Raw Imagery Impacting Your AI: Should You Care?
items.decision_boundary: Space vessel-detection evidence is not a phone Bayer RAW benchmark.

items.title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
items.decision_boundary: Bounded memory and revisitation fidelity do not establish mobile real-time physics prediction.

items.title: Huawei Ruiying Z10 official-source intake
items.decision_boundary: Official indexed specifications only; processing division, first-release date and independent performance require verification.

items.title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
items.decision_boundary: Robotic task success on partly simulated or pseudo-RAW inputs; not human photographic IQ, demosaicing, or mobile deployment evidence.

items.title: HarnessIR: Harnessing Multimodal Foundation Models for Universal Real-World Image Restoration
items.decision_boundary: Closed or external MFM executors and verifier blind spots prevent treating benchmark gains as factual restoration guarantees.

events.change: arXiv v2; version diff not yet verified

items.title: A General Pipeline for Dense Illuminant Estimation via Physically Based Synthetic Data
items.decision_boundary: Indoor synthetic pretraining; real sensor spectra, outdoor scenes and temporal AWB behavior remain unverified.

items.title: LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration
items.decision_boundary: 0.884M parameters and V100 experiments do not establish end-to-end mobile 4K latency, power, bandwidth or thermal behavior.

items.title: EditJudgeBias: Diagnosing Cue and Position Bias in Image Editing Evaluators
items.decision_boundary: Observed cue and order sensitivity applies to tested judges, prompts and edits; it does not invalidate all multimodal evaluators.

items.title: Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing
items.decision_boundary: High reward inference budget; author repository says code coming soon, so reproducibility is not yet established.

items.title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
items.decision_boundary: Proxy-based remapping and desktop-GPU timings do not establish universal perception or mobile interactive performance.

items.title: Lights, Camera, Attack: Exploiting Temporal HDR Fusion with Pulsed Light
items.decision_boundary: Targets sequential temporal HDR; physical success and proof-of-concept defense are scene and device dependent.

items.title: OPPO Find X10 global launch preview
items.decision_boundary: Official preannouncement; combinations, sustained recording, thermal limits, color matching and hidden ISP/NPU topology remain unverified.

events.note: Already notified by daily intake; weekly brief does not relabel it as a new discovery.

items.title: Neural Block-wise Auto-exposure for Single-Shot High Dynamic Range Imaging
items.decision_boundary: Spatial AE is useful only if sensor readout and tone mapping support it; no mobile deployment evidence.

items.title: DuSRFlow: Dual-Lens Super-Resolution via Parallax-Aware Flow Estimation and Complementary Reference Warping
items.decision_boundary: Synthetic foreground supervision and author benchmarks do not establish mobile latency or cross-sensor robustness.

items.title: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
items.decision_boundary: Matched replay with references and a fixed tool pool is not no-reference deployment evidence.

items.title: BluePixel: Toward Native 4K Agentic Image Editing
items.decision_boundary: 8.7 seconds on a Kunlunxin P800 XPU is not mobile latency or power evidence; shared reward bias remains.

items.title: ScenePercept: Scenario-Conditioned Perceptual Assessment of Real-World User-Generated Content Images
items.decision_boundary: Scenario semantics may dominate physical quality; cross-device and cross-cultural validity remain unverified.

items.title: OLiVES: An Outdoor Low-Light Video Benchmark for Enhancement and Segmentation
items.decision_boundary: Daylight ND simulation and controlled motion do not represent true handheld night imaging.

items.title: Physics-Shaped, Not Physical: Auditing Physics-Guided Underwater Image Restoration
items.decision_boundary: One architecture, 800 images and 256-square training do not refute physics-guided restoration generally.

items.title: Unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration via Linear Illumination and Frequency-Adaptive Enhancement
items.decision_boundary: 这是采集后的 exposure correction，不是硬件 AE 闭环。完全饱和区无法从观测中恢复真实纹理；跨相机主要是可视化，动态场景、手机时延/功耗/热均未验证。

items.title: MESS: Multi-Exposure Sequence Synthesis for Generalizable Image Enhancement
items.decision_boundary: 500K 是合成对而非真实多曝光测量；生成的是 plausible RGB exposure，不保留特定相机真实 RAW/CRF。NR-IQA 改善不等于无伪色或真实物理一致性，也没有手机端部署证据。

events.note: Rechecked selected primary sections and connected to historical data-synthesis survey; RawGen relation is survey synthesis, not direct inheritance.

items.title: S3D-Mosaic: Subgradient-Guided Cross-Band Structure Transfer for Spectral Demosaicing
items.decision_boundary: MSFA 与手机 RGB Bayer/Quad-Bayer 的采样、光谱响应和噪声不同；100 次 ADMM 等迭代未证明移动实时。无 GT 的少量真实场景不能证明逐波段光谱保真。

items.title: Interpretable Face Contrast Modeling for Smartphone Portrait Rendering
items.decision_boundary: 人台使主体、姿态与表情受控，也限制真实肤色、妆容、运动和社会偏好外推；真人验证规模较小。对比度相关性不是整体 portrait IQ，更不是跨文化偏好共识。

items.title: WorldSR: Harnessing World Knowledge Search for Grounded Image Super-Resolution
items.decision_boundary: 检索依赖实体分解、语料覆盖与参考歧义，成本与隐私边界未解决；NR-IQA 增益不证明细节真实。它是检索增强 SR，不是可预测动作后果的 world simulator。

items.title: CheckDistill: Adaptive Checklist Distillation for Efficient Distributional Reward Modeling in Image Editing
items.decision_boundary: 三组准确率不可合并为通用正确率；teacher agreement 只是可靠性 proxy，不能排除共同偏差和 reward hacking。自动 judge 提升不等于身份、文字与未编辑区事实保真。

items.title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
items.decision_boundary: 100 个八轮 session 与 failure-triggered IF/CC 计分规则不等于任意长度稳定；共享 judge 可能偏向 teacher 风格。大权重、训练和推理成本未给手机可行性。

items.title: VHA: VQA-based Hallucination Assessment for Generative Image Super-Resolution
items.decision_boundary: 需要 ground-truth reference，不是部署时无参考 detector；VHA+ 继承 VLM label 和训练分布。benchmark 由下采样 GT 构造，不能覆盖所有真实未知退化。

items.title: RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation
items.decision_boundary: 规范化线性生成结果不是该场景唯一真实传感器观测。相机映射要求标定信息；简单噪声模型不能代表所有传感器、光学和 ISP 特性。任意相机适配不等于无需相机信息。
